audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was given to Neeko while whys[0] on the same page says 'the level 1-2 window is even', and Level 6 was given to Neeko while whys[4] says 'you own the all-in at 6'.
audit.why: The packet chart (Skill, Skill, Irelia, Irelia, Irelia, Irelia, Irelia) agrees with the prose in both places. Neeko is a squishy poke mage with no way to convert Level 1 chip, and at 6 Irelia's Vanguard's Edge cuts her repositioning.

audit.why: Spike order holds: Neeko's pre-3 poke window, Irelia's level-3 E, Pop Blossom at 6 (120/105/90s), first item. First-item spike renamed to the item the page actually builds.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three passages credit Irelia's passive with 'armor/MR shred' (whys[5], spikes[3].text, mid) and two call it the 'Bladesurge passive'. The passive is Ionian Fervor: stacking Attack Speed, plus bonus on-hit damage at max stacks. It shreds no resistances and it is not Bladesurge.
audit.why: Riot kit text for Irelia's passive. The shred claim is what the page uses to explain why the first-item all-in melts her, which is a wrong mechanism for a correct conclusion — the real reason is Blade of the Ruined King's %HP damage plus max attack speed on a target with no sustain.
audit.corrected: Replaced with max-stack Ionian Fervor attack speed / on-hit damage and BotRK %HP.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing stated what makes Tangle-Barbs worse when it is not dodged clean.
audit.why: Riot text: 'If the tangle kills an enemy or passes through a champion, it becomes larger, faster, and roots for longer.' Standing behind a dying minion or a teammate is what turns a short root into a long one.
audit.corrected: Written into dontsFull[1].d, and its 12s rank-1 cooldown into dosFull[2].d and the win condition.

audit.why: Inconsistent pronouns on the same page read as generated filler and undermine trust in the specific advice next to them.
audit.corrected: Fixed in tldr, winCon, enemyWin, report[0].t and report[1].t. The remaining boilerplate ('If Neeko gets a kill... he snowballs') is unchanged here only because those strings are shared templates; flagged in notes.

edits.before: This is your takeover. At 3 your E (Flawless Duet) stun into a Bladesurge reset bursts a squishy Neeko faster than she can react, and from 4-5 your max-stack passive on-hit plus armor/MR shred makes every all-in lethal. Watch her W — she can disguise as a minion or use the passive move speed to bait your E onto the wrong target, so confirm the real Neeko before you commit. At 6 her Pop Blossom (R) is the only thing that scares you, but the channel is interruptible: E-stun her mid-cast to cancel it, or R-wall her escape so she can't reposition for the engage.
edits.after: This is your takeover. At 3 your E (Flawless Duet) stun into a Bladesurge reset bursts a squishy Neeko faster than she can react, and from 4-5 your max-stack Ionian Fervor attack speed and on-hit damage make every all-in lethal. Watch her W — she sends a clone in a direction and can recast to steer it, so confirm the real Neeko before you spend E. At 6 her Pop Blossom (R) is the only thing that scares you: it has a preparation before the leap, and Riot hides that prep entirely while she is disguised, so track her R cooldown rather than the animation.

notes: Level 1 and Level 6 rows flipped to match both the packet chart and the whys text already on the page. The 'armor/MR shred' passive fiction appears three times and is corrected to Ionian Fervor attack speed. UNVERIFIED, deliberately left in place: spikes[2].text, whys[4] and wants.you[2] all assert that Irelia's E-stun cancels the Pop Blossom channel mid-cast. Riot's text says only 'After a short preparation, Neeko leaps into the air' and the kit file carries no channel flag on her R, so I could not confirm interruptibility from the kits and did not want to invent either answer. The mid paragraph was rewritten to lean on the one thing Riot's text does state — the preparation is hidden while she is disguised — instead of the unverified interrupt. If the user can confirm the interrupt, spikes[2].text and wants.you[2] can stay as-is.
